_comment: Hoenn & Seek 2.0 (parts 8a-11): interiors for HnS's fake buildings (2.0-plan section 3a).
Read by tools/hoenn/gen_hoenn_buildings.py; the per-building plan is hoenn-docs/buildings.md and
templates: name -> {from: an HnS house map}. A building uses that map's layout (furniture and all),
its signs (bookshelves, TV...) and its entrance tile; HnS has dozens of 13x10 house maps (yellow tile,
wood floor, Mr. POKéMON's white office), so buildings vary by picking different ones (no new tiles).
buildings: {name (map folder, ends in _hoenn), door {map, x, y}, template, purpose, music (optional,
default: the outside map's), signs (optional), texts (optional), objects}.
signs: [{x, y, text}] replaces the template's signs ([] = none; leave it out to keep them).
texts: {Key: text} becomes <name>_Text_<Key>, for hand-written scripts in data/scripts/hoenn_buildings.inc.
{type: npc, gfx, x, y, facing (down/up/left/right/wander/look), text (string or list of boxes) or
script (a hand-written script label instead of text), or daily_gift {flag (a daily flag), items
(7 item names without ITEM_, Sunday first), intro, after, full (bag full), done} instead of text,
hints (optional: hint line ids from data/hoenn/npc_hints.json, makes them a hint NPC)}
or {type: mon, species, x, y, facing}: a Pokémon object that plays its cry (house pets).
Every object must stand on a free floor tile, not on or right above the entrance. In the 13x10
houses the chairs (left and right of the table, and the row above them) are walkable: keep NPCs off them.

buildings.name: Route34_FishingShack_hoenn
buildings.purpose: Fisherman's shack on Route 34's shore (part 8a's test interior).

text: The fish off ROUTE 34 bite best in the early morning.
Don't tell anyone, but on rainy days you'll hook POLIWAG right off the beach!

objects.text: My husband spends more time at sea than at home. Lucky for him, the fish keep us fed!

buildings.name: OlivineCity_HarborOffice_hoenn
buildings.purpose: Harbor office: ship schedules for the S.S. AQUA and the HOENN ferry, a clerk who hints about Hoenn.

signs.text: Logbooks of every ship that has docked in OLIVINE, going back fifty years.
Logbooks of every ship that has docked in OLIVINE, going back fifty years.
Tide tables for the waters around OLIVINE and CIANWOOD.
Tide tables for the waters around OLIVINE and CIANWOOD.

text: A chart of the sea routes.
A line runs from OLIVINE to VERMILION, and a long dotted one from VERMILION far to the south, to SLATEPORT CITY in HOENN.
A chart of the sea routes.
A line runs from OLIVINE to VERMILION, and a long dotted one from VERMILION far to the south, to SLATEPORT CITY in HOENN.

signs.text: The ship-to-shore radio crackles: “...calm seas past CIANWOOD... light winds...”
The ship-to-shore radio crackles: “...calm seas past CIANWOOD... light winds...”

text: Welcome to the OLIVINE HARBOR OFFICE!
The S.S. AQUA sails between OLIVINE and VERMILION CITY. The board at the port has its sailing days.
I just signed on with the HOENN ferry out of VERMILION.
Warm seas, wild WAILMER, and the ship docks right in SLATEPORT. Can't wait!

objects.text: I've waited an hour to ask about my lost luggage. The clerk keeps talking about the weather!

buildings.name: OlivineCity_SailorsHouse_hoenn
buildings.purpose: Sailor's family home: the sailor is away at sea, his kids are home, and there's a Wingull pet.

text: My husband sails on the S.S. AQUA.
He's at sea half the week, so the kids and the WINGULL keep me busy!

objects.text: Dad brought WINGULL home from VERMILION. It follows the ships all the way across the sea!
When I grow up, I'm going to captain my own ship and sail all the way to HOENN!

buildings.name: OlivineCity_CaptainsHouse_hoenn
buildings.purpose: Retired captain: sea stories, and he rates your Pokémon's friendship.

RateIntro: Forty years I captained ships out of this port. You learn to read a crew.
Let's have a look at your {STR_VAR_1}...
texts.Rate0: Hmph. That one would mutiny the first chance it got. Treat it better, sailor.
texts.Rate1: It keeps its distance from you, like a deckhand who doesn't trust the captain yet.
texts.Rate2: It's not used to you yet. Give it time at sea together.
texts.Rate3: It's getting used to you. A few more voyages and you'll be a fine crew.
texts.Rate4: It likes you quite a lot! It would follow you through any storm.
texts.Rate5: It's very happy with you. That's a first mate if I ever saw one!
texts.Rate6: Ha! It adores you! With a partner like that, no fog could ever get you lost.

text: My husband still tells the story of the night a LAPRAS led his ship through the fog off CIANWOOD.
I've heard it three hundred times. I still like it.

buildings.name: OlivineCity_TackleShop_hoenn
buildings.purpose: Fishing tackle shop: a small mart (Net/Dive/Lure Balls, Repels).

signs.text: Fishing line, hooks and lures, sorted by size.
Fishing line, hooks and lures, sorted by size.

text: A LURE BALL for anything you hook, a NET BALL for WATER and BUG types...
And a DIVE BALL for anything you meet under the waves. This shop has all three!

buildings.name: OlivineCity_Shipwright_hoenn
buildings.purpose: Shipwright's workshop: workers, and talk of the lighthouse and Amphy.

signs.text: Blueprints for a new ferry. They're stamped “S.S. TIDAL, SLATEPORT SHIPYARD.”
Blueprints for a new ferry. They're stamped “S.S. TIDAL, SLATEPORT SHIPYARD.”

text: We repair every ship that docks in OLIVINE.
The shipyard in SLATEPORT sent us these plans so we can fix their ferry when it's in port.
No captain sails at night without the LIGHTHOUSE.
When AMPHY fell ill, JASMINE stayed by its side until it could shine again. Every sailor here owes her one.

objects.text: Steel hulls, strong as a STEELIX! Well, almost.

buildings.name: OlivineCity_KeepersHouse_hoenn
buildings.purpose: Lighthouse keeper's family: Jasmine and Amphy lines, and a daily item.

daily_gift.intro: The tide leaves all sorts of things on the rocks below the LIGHTHOUSE. I go down every morning. Here's today's find!
daily_gift.after: Come back tomorrow. The sea always brings something new.
daily_gift.full: Oh, your BAG is full! I'll keep it for you until you make room.
daily_gift.done: I've already been down to the rocks today. Come back tomorrow!

text: I've kept the LIGHTHOUSE for thirty years, and AMPHY lights the lamp now.
JASMINE climbs up every evening after the GYM closes, just to say goodnight to it.

buildings.name: EcruteakCity_DanceTeacher_hoenn
buildings.purpose: Kimono dance teacher's house: students practicing, and Eevee pets.

text: I taught the KIMONO GIRLS of the DANCE THEATER, every one of them.
A dance is like a battle. Every step must flow into the next!
One, two, turn... Oh! You surprised me.
I'm practicing for my first show at the DANCE THEATER.

objects.text: Our teacher says EEVEE dance better than any of us. I think she's right!

buildings.name: Route34_BreedersHouse_hoenn
buildings.purpose: Breeder's house next to the Day Care: egg and breeding tips, with a hint NPC.

text: We moved here to be next door to the DAY-CARE.
Every morning I check whether the couple found another EGG!
A POKéMON from an EGG can know moves its parents knew.
Breed with care and you'll get a strong one right from the start!

buildings.name: Route38_MoomooStoreroom_hoenn
buildings.purpose: Moomoo Farm storeroom: a farmhand, Miltank, and a Moomoo Milk line.

signs.text: Crates of MOOMOO MILK bottles, packed and ready for GOLDENROD's DEPT. STORE.
Crates of MOOMOO MILK bottles, packed and ready for GOLDENROD's DEPT. STORE.

text: MOOMOO MILK from this farm goes all over JOHTO.
One bottle restores 100 HP. Ask at the farmhouse if you want to buy some!

objects.text: This MILTANK gives the best milk on the farm. She likes it in here where it's cool.

buildings.name: BellchimeTrail_Lodge_hoenn
buildings.purpose: Tin Tower caretaker's lodge: sages, with legendary-bird rumors.

signs.text: A worn scroll. It shows TIN TOWER, and a great bird of many colors circling above it.
A worn scroll. It shows TIN TOWER, and a great bird of many colors circling above it.

text: We sweep TIN TOWER's steps every dawn, though the bird of many colors has not landed there in years.
They say it comes only for a TRAINER it has chosen.
The bird of TIN TOWER has a partner, they say, one that sleeps under the sea.
Some fishermen swear they've heard it singing near the WHIRL ISLANDS.

objects.text: The BELL TOWER's bells ring out with the wind. A good sage can tell the weather by their tune.

buildings.name: Route6_BugClub_hoenn
buildings.purpose: Bug Catchers' club house: bug tips, and a Butterfree pet.

text: Welcome to the ROUTE 6 BUG CLUB! Members only... but you can look around.
Our club rule: never let a BUG POKéMON go hungry!
Bug POKéMON evolve fast. CATERPIE becomes BUTTERFREE before you know it!
That's why they're the best.

objects.text: I want to join, but I've only caught a WEEDLE. They say I need three kinds to be a member.

buildings.name: Route6_EngineersHouse_hoenn
buildings.purpose: Retired Silph engineer: talk of the Magnet Train and the Power Plant, with a hint NPC.

text: I worked thirty years at SILPH CO. I helped design the MAGNET TRAIN's motors!
It runs on electricity from the POWER PLANT. Without it, the whole line stops.
My husband retired, but he still takes the MAGNET TRAIN to GOLDENROD every week.
He says he's checking the motors. I think he just likes the ride.

buildings.name: CeladonCity_FloristsHouse_hoenn
buildings.purpose: Florist's house: flowers, Bellossom, and a berry gift.

signs.text: A vase of fresh flowers from the garden by the pond.
A vase of fresh flowers from the garden by the pond.

intro: I grow flowers for ERIKA's GYM, and berries along the pond.
Here, take one of today's berries!
daily_gift.after: A different berry ripens every day of the week. Come back tomorrow!
daily_gift.full: Oh, your BAG is full. Make some room and I'll pick one for you.
daily_gift.done: That was today's berry. Come back tomorrow, there's always another!

text: Our BELLOSSOM dances whenever the sun comes out.
On rainy days it just sits by the window and sulks!

buildings.name: MelemeleIsle_IslandHome_hoenn
buildings.purpose: Island family home: Alola-style lines and pets (Rockruff, Pikipek).

text: Alola! Come in, come in. Visitors are always welcome here.
Out on the islands, nobody locks their door. The POKéMON would just let themselves in anyway!
Every morning our PIKIPEK wakes the whole house, right at sunrise.
No need for an alarm clock on MELEMELE!

objects.text: ROCKRUFF and I are going to do the island challenge together when I'm older!

buildings.name: MelemeleIsle_SurfShop_hoenn
buildings.purpose: Surf shop: surfing tips and Wailmer talk (a small mart: Dive/Net Balls, Sea/Wave Incense, Mystic Water).

text: Big waves come in after a storm. That's the best time to surf!
Out past the reef there's a WAILMER pod. If you're lucky, one will ride the swell right beside you.

objects.text: Our shop's WAILMER is too big to fit through the door now. We have to wash it with a hose!
